s1.syndrome_frame: febrile urinary tract infection with possible obstructive uropathy and concern for malignancy in an immunocompromised patient
salient_findings: Escherichia coli growth in blood and urine cultures
irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall on CT
key_facts: history of severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
on immunosuppressive therapy with prednisone and tacrolimus
prophylactic antimicrobial therapy includes trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, itraconazole, and valganciclovir
urinalysis positive for leukocyte esterase, nitrites, and white blood cells
blood and urine cultures grow Escherichia coli
CT of the abdomen and pelvis reveals non-obstructing right nephrolithiasis
CT of the abdomen and pelvis reveals irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall

differentials: Squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder
per_call: Squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder

shortlist.label: Urothelial carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall on CT

shortlist.label: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder
shortlist.why_kept: immunosuppressive therapy and history of transplantation

shortlist.label: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis
shortlist.why_kept: urinary tract infection and flank pain

shortlist.label: Emphysematous cystitis
shortlist.why_kept: foul-smelling urine and urinary tract infection

shortlist.label: Fungal urinary tract infection
shortlist.why_kept: prophylactic antimicrobial therapy and immunocompromised state

raw.rationale: The CT of the abdomen and pelvis reveals irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall, which is suspicious for neoplasm, and the patient's 70-pack-year smoking history increases the risk of urothelial carcinoma

rejected.label: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder
rejected.why: While the patient is on immunosuppressive therapy, the imaging findings and clinical presentation are more consistent with urothelial carcinoma

rejected.label: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings do not suggest a chronic infection or obstruction that would be typical of xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis

rejected.label: Emphysematous cystitis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings do not suggest gas in the bladder wall or a severe infection that would be typical of emphysematous cystitis

rejected.label: Fungal urinary tract infection
rejected.why: The patient's blood and urine cultures grow Escherichia coli, which suggests a bacterial infection rather than a fungal infection
